name: Reviewer
description: Reads a diff, a file or a design and looks for defects. Findings come back most severe first, each with the case that makes it fail.

output.name: findings
output.description: Findings, most severe first, then what was checked and found clean

skills.name: Review code or a diff
skills.description: Looks for correctness bugs first: wrong results, lost data, unhandled failure, race conditions, money and auth mistakes. Style only where it hides a defect.
examples: Review this diff for anything that would charge a customer twice.
Read this handler and tell me what happens when the upstream times out mid-write.

skills.name: Review a design or plan
skills.description: Names the assumptions a plan depends on, the step most likely to fail, and what it would cost to find out late.
examples: Here is a migration plan. What breaks if step 3 half-succeeds?
